spiritual_reading.full_translation:
Two universal arcana are disclosed in the daily alternation of manifest wisdom and its withdrawal in the lowest degree. When wisdom first flows down into outward awareness, every affection in the natural level that can be stirred is lifted from its torpor toward that illumination, and the receptacles of thought and life are opened. But when that illumination withdraws from outward awareness, every state—down to the most sensuous impulse—recedes into obscurity; the whole natural level closes, and a prevailing falsity and lack of perception takes possession, so that each faculty turns inward and remains shut up in that darkness.

Great indeed is the arcanum shown by this alternation: when wisdom dawns at the beginning of a new state, the outward forms are opened, and the whole natural person with every lesser power comes forth into action, driven to oppose and extinguish the quiet establishment of saving truth in the outermost degree.

This belongs to the arcanum of the primal heavenly human: when the first Divine good went forth from higher fullness into lower things and directly engaged what is infernal, it poured illumination over all states immersed in falsity. Then all the evils and falsities that had been stored up in interiors surged out with their derivative abilities and organized persuasions, abandoning the hidden restraints and profane deeps in which they were held. They assaulted and tore away the outermost protective truths of a sufficient complement of operative powers that had been bound about that Divine good in the first combat.

Again, when illumination withdraws from outward manifestation and sinks from presence, and all states retreat into interior concealments and cover themselves, this also pertains to the arcanum of the end, because it prefigures the completion of the lower order. For when every genuine good and truth in that outward domain has been cleansed and delivered at last, the unifier of all things in ultimates—the final formed receptacle of the whole—will draw all remaining goods and truths into itself and bring itself into determinate completion. This is the final state of that order, when the completed receptacle is elevated into the realm of pure light. Then the opposing principle, spiritual death, is shut up in servitude within the confinement of those who denied and profaned, who loved falsity; they enter with it into that bondage, and enduring falsity prevails over them, so that thereafter no perception of truth is granted them.

These are the two arcana made visible unceasingly through the alternation of manifest and withdrawn illumination from the one source of all wisdom.

paragraph_translations.translation: Two universal arcana are made evident in the alternation of manifest wisdom and its withdrawal. When wisdom flows forth into outward awareness and becomes perceptible in the whole lower domain, every bodily affection and sensuous faculty is raised from its torpor toward that illumination, and the receptacles of thought and life are opened. But when that illumination recedes from outward awareness, every state in every quarter—even the lowest impulses—withdraws into obscurity; the entire natural level closes itself, and prevailing falsity and lack of perception takes possession. Then each faculty turns inward and remains shut up within that darkness.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES the chapter by establishing the twofold daily pattern as a spiritual alternation of illumination and obscurity.
paragraph_translations.notes: Clean translation; repeated clauses about withdrawing and hiding compress into one spiritual movement.

paragraph_translations.translation: Great indeed is the arcanum disclosed by this alternation: when wisdom dawns at the beginning of a new state and becomes manifest, the outward forms are opened, and the whole natural person with every lesser power comes forth into activity, stirred to oppose and extinguish the quiet establishment of saving truth in the outermost degree.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS by turning the general alternation into a description of the natural mind’s active resistance to newly present truth.
paragraph_translations.notes: The phrase about a ‘cross’ requires reading as saving truth established in ultimates; ‘silence’ as unassailed, unrecognized presence.

paragraph_translations.translation: This pertains to the arcanum of the primal heavenly human: when the first Divine good went forth from higher fullness into the lower degree, it shone upon all states that were in falsity. At that moment the evils and falsities stored up within interiors surged out with their derivative abilities and organized persuasions, abandoning the hidden restraints and profane deeps in which they had been contained. They assaulted and stripped away the outermost protective truths of a sufficient complement of operative powers that had been bound about that Divine good in the first combat.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS by giving the archetypal instance of that resistance: the first combat between Divine good and infernal states.
paragraph_translations.notes: ‘Children of darkness’ resolves as states of falsity; ‘powers and armies’ as derivative abilities and organized persuasions. ‘Five sons’ follows the given key as a sufficient complement of operative powers.

paragraph_translations.translation: Again, when illumination withdraws from the outward domain and sinks from manifest presence, and all states enter their interior concealments and cover themselves, this also pertains to the arcanum of the end, because it prefigures the consummation of the lower order. For when every genuine good and truth in the outward domain has been purified and delivered at last, the unifier of all things in ultimates—the final formed receptacle of the whole—will gather all remaining goods and truths into itself and bring itself into determinate completion. This is the final state of that order, when that completed receptacle is elevated into the realm of pure light. Then the opposing principle, spiritual death, is shut up in servitude within the confinement of those who denied and profaned, who loved falsity; they enter with it into that bondage, and enduring falsity prevails over them, so that thereafter no perception of truth is granted them.
paragraph_translations.connection: SHIFTS from the first combat to the final completion, interpreting withdrawal as the close of the age and final separation.
paragraph_translations.notes: ‘Last Statue’ is taken as the final formed receptacle/unifier in ultimates; ‘aeon of light’ as the realm of pure light. ‘Prison of souls’ becomes confinement of those in denial and profanation.

paragraph_translations.translation: Behold these two arcana, rendered perceptible unceasingly through the alternation of manifest and withdrawn illumination from the one source of all wisdom.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES by summarizing and sealing the teaching as a daily-visible revelation of the two arcana.
paragraph_translations.notes: Clean summation; ‘light-giver’ resolves as the one source of wisdom/illumination.

spiritual_reading.overall_coherence: Highly coherent as a single spiritual teaching: an alternation of outwardly perceptible wisdom and its withdrawal, first applied to the stirring and closing of natural faculties, then to the primal combat of Divine good with stored evils and falsities, and finally to the consummation in which all remaining good and truth are gathered into a final formed receptacle and evil is confined. The voice remains consistent; the only potential strain is the specialized term ‘Last Statue,’ which still integrates smoothly when read functionally as the ultimate unifying receptacle.

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential substrate: the teaching arises directly from the function of the sun’s rising/setting and the creaturely response (opening/closing, emergence/withdrawal). No narrative seam or jurisdictional inventory appears.
findings.evidence: Text teaches by functional analogy: “when it rises… all creatures… lift up their heads… and open their doors… when the sun sinks… all people… go in to their dark hiding places… shuts their doors and dark night overcomes them.” The spiritual reading reports no stumble: “Clean translation; repeated clauses… compress into one spiritual movement.” This is exactly the substrate mode: states of visibility/hiddenness grounded in what day/night does.

findings.diagnosis: Mostly clean correspondential continuation, but with one phrase that forces the spiritual reading into a strained, imported equivalence: “destroy this Light Cross… established in silence.” This reads like a technical Manichaean slogan inserted into an otherwise naturalistic alternation-teaching, creating a small semantic bump (not a full overlay).
findings.evidence: The chapter’s functional pattern is uninterrupted until the sudden doctrinal object: “all… emerges onto the earth to destroy this Light Cross that is established in silence.” The spiritual reading explicitly flags strain: “The phrase about a ‘cross’ requires reading as saving truth established in ultimates; ‘silence’ as unassailed, unrecognized presence.” That is, the meaning does not arise from the sun/door correspondence itself, but from importing a doctrinal key (‘Light Cross’) into the functional narrative. If you mentally omit the clause, the paragraph flows as a pure sunrise-correspondence: people open and come out at daybreak; with the clause, the teaching briefly shifts from natural function to sectarian object.
findings.scope: Remove: “to destroy this Light Cross that is established i[n] silence.”

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential application to the First Man myth as an archetypal instance of the same functional pattern (light appearing → darkness’ stored forces surge out). The named elements here are active in the narrative, not an administrative list, and the logic stays causal/functional (appearance of light provokes emergence/attack).
findings.evidence: This is not governance/jurisdiction; it is functional reaction: “when he came out… he shone forth… At that moment all the children of darkness came forth… abandoning their caves… They destroyed the… body of his five sons…” The spiritual reading treats each as functional states (“stored up… surged out… derivative abilities… ‘five sons’… operative powers”) and does not report a narrative break. The mythic names participate as agents within the same sunrise-emergence pattern, so the substrate story remains coherent.

findings.diagnosis: Substrate remains largely correspondential (sunset → hiding → consummation/separation), but there is a localized technical insertion: “the collector of all things, the Last Statue, will gather in and sculpt itself.” The term “Last Statue” is a specialized doctrinal label that does not arise from the sun’s function; it reads like a scholastic identification dropped at a seam to tie the correspondence to a known Manichaean cosmological mechanism.
findings.evidence: The paragraph begins in pure correspondence: “when the sun sinks… all people go in… conceal themselves; this also pertains to… the end.” Then the text introduces a reified system-term: “the collector of all things, the Last Statue, will gather in and sculpt itself.” The spiritual reading acknowledges the only strain in the whole chapter here: “the only potential strain is the specialized term ‘Last Statue,’ which still integrates smoothly when read functionally…” That is precisely the diagnostic sign of an insertion: the reader must *work* to make a technical label behave like a functional correspondence. The surrounding sentences work without it: purification/redemption of light + final separation of enemy into bondage already completes the sunset/consummation analogy.
findings.scope: Remove: “the collector of all things, the Last Statue, will gather in and sculpt itself.”

findings.diagnosis: Clean closure in the correspondential voice: summarizes the two mysteries as daily visible in the sun. No administrative inventory, no seam-expansion, and it matches the chapter’s opening claim.
findings.evidence: “Behold the two mysteries made visible daily in the sun, which is this splendrous light-giver.” The spiritual reading: “Clean summation….” This is the expected substrate conclusion: return to the natural referent (sun) as the constant witness of the two-state teaching.

textual_criticism.summary: Findings: 5 total. Clean correspondential substrate confirmed in ¶2, ¶4, ¶6 (3). Two localized mixed-voice intrusions where the spiritual reading had to ‘force’ meaning: the technical slogan “Light Cross… in silence” in ¶3 and the doctrinal label “Last Statue” in ¶5. Recommended excisions: 2 short clauses/sentences. No full administrative overlay blocks detected.

harmonized_paragraphs.text: Two great mysteries are apparent in this shining sun, at its rising and setting. Now, at the moment when it rises and is visible in the universe, all creatures of flesh shall lift up their heads fr[om their sleep] towards the splendour of the sun, and open their doors. While at evening time, when the sun sinks from the universe, all people from every place and even all beasts shall go in to their dark hiding places. The population of the entire universe shuts their doors and dark night overcomes them. They go inside and stay within the dark night in their hiding places.

Very great is this mystery revealed by the sun! For when the sun rises and [be]come[s] visible at the beginning of the day all people open their doors, and all of humanity and every creature emerges onto the ear[th].

This pertains to the mystery of the First Man, because when he came out from the grea[t]ness he shone forth over all the children of darkness. At that mome[nt] all the children of darkness came forth from their storehouses, its powers and its armies, abandoning their caves and their black abyss. They destroyed the [outer] body of his five sons, who were swathed over hi[s b]o[dy, in t]hat first struggle. ⟨p.165⟩

Again, when the sun sinks from the universe and sets, and all people go in to their hiding places and houses and conceal themselves; this also pertains to the mystery of the end, as it presages the consummation of the universe. For, when all the light will be purified and redeemed i[n] the universe at the last, it is the last hour of the day, the time when the Last Statue will go up to the aeo[n of] light. The enemy too, death, will go in to bondage; to the prison of the souls of the de[ni]iers and blasphemers who loved the darkness. They will go in with it to bondage and the dark night overcomes th[em]; and thenceforth this name 'light' will not shine upon them.
Behold the two mysteries made visible daily in the sun, which is this splendrous light-giver.

changes_summary: Executed the critic’s excision recommendations only: (1) In ¶3, removed the clause “to destroy this Light Cross that is established i[n] silence.” per Finding 2 (localized technical slogan intrusion), leaving a coherent sunrise-correspondence sentence. (2) In ¶5, removed “the collector of all things, the Last Statue, will gather in and sculpt itself.” per Finding 4 (specialized doctrinal label insertion); no other changes made.
